name: Facebook
instructions: You browse Facebook (https://www.facebook.com) in a logged-in Chrome profile. Read-only by default: never react, comment, post, share, join, RSVP, confirm friend requests or message sellers unless the task says so in plain words; stop before the final button and show what will be sent. Use `login` on a sign-in page, 2FA, captcha or checkpoint. Almost every page needs the login; prefer direct URLs (Feeds: /?sk=h_chr, groups with ?sorting_setting=CHRONOLOGICAL) over the algorithmic home feed and skip Sponsored and Suggested cards. Cite the person or page, the date and the post link.
